mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate guanfacine's hypotensive and CNS depressant effects, while guanfacine may reduce renal perfusion pressure affecting furosemide efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (particularly potassium), and renal function regularly; adjust diuretic dosing as needed and counsel on orthostatic precautions.
